gotchas.text: Image: the recipe boot script defaults to spark-vllm:qwen38, which its run log describes as eugr/spark-vllm:latest of 2026-08-14 with ffmpeg 6.1.1 added, and which is not published. These rows ran on eugr/spark-vllm:nightly-20260814, repo digest sha256:ab89584706575a7af48a3d5a2a92bc48a5432781fb87925a181d8bb5eab4f5d3, image id a0cb301789ef, the id the recipe run log records for eugr/spark-vllm:latest. Its build-metadata.yaml names vllm-project/vllm main aa3100357 with no extra pull requests. ffmpeg is absent; it matters only for video and image input.

Boot lottery: this boot allocated 72.47 GiB of KV cache, 1,250,962 tokens, 4.77x concurrency at 262144, with gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 and 114.83 of 121.63 GiB free at startup. The recipe README reports 1,161,326 tokens (4.43x) for the same settings on its machine. vLLM padded the KV groups with 2 and 4 layers and warns the second may waste up to 25 per cent of that group.

KV cache dtype is not set by the recipe (kv-cache-dtype auto), but unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 carries a static per-tensor 8-bit float kv_cache_scheme in its quantization_config, and FlashInfer resolved kv_cache_dtype float8_e4m3fn with the xqa decode backend. The recipe omits --attention-backend on purpose; vLLM picked FLASHINFER out of FLASHINFER and TRITON_ATTN, and FlashInfer serves the draft model non-causal attention.

Neither the target nor the drafter is pinned. unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 resolved to main f0b7c9e7 (2026-09-08). The recipe run log names snapshot a767244, which no longer exists in the repository history after the 2026-08-15 super-squash; every file except README.md has the same content hash at 16b6615a (the squash), 57926bac and f0b7c9e7. Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM resolved to ebaa0919 (2026-08-16), its only upload: 5 layers, bf16, block_size 7, 2.6 GB.

DSpark runs with 14 speculative tokens against a drafter whose config says block_size 7, and probabilistic draft sampling. During the pre-run sanity requests (thinking on and off, greedy, 64 + 512 + 512 tokens) vLLM counted 339 drafts, 4,746 draft tokens and 757 accepted, 16 per cent, a mean acceptance length of 3.2 tokens per step; positions 9 to 14 accepted almost nothing on prose-like output. The README 75 to 78 tok/s is a 3,000-token edit that copies code already in the prompt, where it reports 68 per cent acceptance.
vLLM reads generation_config.json from the target and overrides its own sampling defaults with temperature 1.0, top_k 20, top_p 0.95. Every request here sets temperature 0 and seed 42.

Speed rows force thinking off per request with chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false. Eval rows use the served default, which is thinking on at full length, because the chat template comes from the target repository unmodified; the recipe sets no reasoning level of its own.

The server runs without an API key and uses host networking on port 8888, the script default. The script also passes VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4=0, which this vLLM build logs as an unknown environment variable, and VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1.

Boot took 11 minutes from docker run to the first answered request: 160 s to load the 22 GB target from a cold page cache, about 2.5 minutes of FlashInfer fp4_gemm autotuning, 50 s of torch.compile and 99 s of CUDA graph capture (51 piecewise and 33 full sizes up to 512 tokens, plus 34 DSpark sizes).

provenance.notes: Served with the "Edit-heavy coding-solo - DSpark k=14" recipe from hiceron/spark-qwen38-27b (https://github.com/hiceron/spark-qwen38-27b, main d097a95), started with its own command GMU=0.85 K=14 ./scripts/boot-bakeer-dspark.sh and the script unmodified. The script defaults IMAGE to spark-vllm:qwen38, a local image the recipe describes as eugr/spark-vllm:latest of 2026-08-14 plus ffmpeg; that image is not published, so IMAGE was set to eugr/spark-vllm:nightly-20260814 (repo digest sha256:ab895847, image id a0cb301789ef, the same id the recipe run log records for eugr/spark-vllm:latest), which reports vLLM 0.27.2rc1.dev88+gaa3100357.d20260814, transformers 5.15.0, FlashInfer 0.6.18 and torch 2.13.0+cu130. ffmpeg is only needed for video and image input, and these rows send text. Target unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 with no revision pin, resolved to main f0b7c9e7; DSpark speculative decoding against Doopeworld/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark-vLLM (5 layers, bf16, resolved to ebaa0919) with 14 speculative tokens and probabilistic draft sampling; gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, max-num-batched-tokens 16384, prefix caching on, the native 262144 window, reasoning parser qwen3, tool parser qwen3_xml with auto tool choice, 2 images and 0 videos per prompt, environment VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1 and VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4=0, host network, port 8888 (the script default). Attention backend, KV cache dtype and max-num-seqs are left to vLLM, which chose FlashInfer and an fp8_e4m3 KV cache from the checkpoint kv_cache_scheme. The chat template comes from the target repository, so the served default is thinking on: the speed rows force thinking off per request with chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false, the eval rows use that served default. The server runs without an API key; the harness attached over HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8888 and sent a bearer header the server ignores.
